user_story: As a user, I want to see the asynchronously loaded content after clicking the 'Start' button so that I can verify that the page loads the content dynamically. The page should initially show a loading message, and upon completion, it should display 'Hello World!'.
acceptance_criteria: The user clicks the button with the text 'Start'.
The user sees the content in the div with id 'finish' that says 'Hello World!'.
The URL remains 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dynamic_loading/1' during the operation.
